name: fine-arts-studio-block-431
estimated: the south face's columns, windows, mullions, sills and heads and its roller doors, with a photograph as a reference; the walls standing 0.35 m in under the eave, the roof's slab and the fascia; the low box's walls stopping short of its roof's west end; and the faces no photograph shows, drawn plainly
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from the car park at the lane's west end, about 7 m out from the south face near its west end, looking east-north-east along it (bearing 7 degrees) through a lens of about 88 degrees across, its principal point solved (the photograph is the upper left of a wider frame); its camera is fitted to the south eave against the sky, the eave's east corner, the low box's corner and four verticals, held near 1.6 m over the LiDAR's ground

building.title: Fine Arts Studio Block 431 (431), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 431's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 431 by its id.

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above 3.06 m over the door's ground (33.09 m), 3 m over the provisional ground the frame was measured from (33.16 m, the median LiDAR ground within the outline's band, as the measured massing took it); the centre from the same points (tower_above), which lie within 1.5 m of the campus map ring. The walls' axis runs along the block's long faces (bearing 252.6 deg), so z faces south-south-east (bearing 162.6 deg), to the lane and its car park, which the photograph looks along

light.note: estimated: the photograph is taken under broken cloud, the south face in soft light with no hard shadow. The viewer's sun stands to the south-south-east (160 deg round, 50 up), before the face, at an exposure of 0.38: the luma (p50) of the face's panels under the middle windows 145 against the photograph's 149 halfway along it and 182 against 168 near the camera, of the panels under the upper windows 183 against 168 (the compare's figure over the model's screen box: 153 against 150)

door.note: under the glass canopy before the east entrance, beside the glass stair tower (the campus map records no lobby or entrance in 431): u -26.5, w 1.0 in the building's frame ((26.5, 1.0) in the view frame). The LiDAR's ground within 1 m: 5 returns, p10/p50/p90 33.053/33.090/33.135 m (the canopy hides the ground under it from the LiDAR); the lane before the south face lies at 33.06 to 33.21
